name: Navua River
bio_draft: River: Upper Navua Gorge whitewater rafting through black volcanic canyon and waterfalls, reached by road from Navua.

name: Biausevu Waterfalls
bio_draft: Waterfall: 20 m tiered waterfall reached by a 20-minute rainforest walk near Biausevu, best just after the wet season.

name: Tavuni Hill Fort
bio_draft: Historic site: semi-restored 18th-century hill fort near Naroro village, with guides on precolonial history.

name: Kula Eco Park
bio_draft: Wildlife park: captive breeding of endangered species and environmental education, Pacific Harbour side; paid entry (east of Sigatoka, check central region).

name: Nananu-i-Ra
bio_draft: Island: small island off Rakiraki reached by boat from Ellington Wharf, with resorts, the One Bay beach and famous dive sites.

name: One Bay Beach
bio_draft: Beach: white sand beach on Nananu-i-Ra with a rainforest behind and an ancient village; a sunset and swimming beach.
